note: Hand-measured from ICAS Seattle livestream recordings and Production Hub logs on 2026-09-22. Each value lists its source and uncertainty. Change a value only with a new measurement, never to make a test pass.

stage_scale.source: Back-wall door in the approved Audience calibration image (0.91 m x 2.03 m door = 0.052 x 0.205 of the frame); consistent with the 16:9 aspect.

stage_layout_reference.source: Approved Audience calibration image and the operator-drawn 'Full Stage' region.

true_ptz_footprint.source: 1365 and 2238 from the calibration sweep (measured directly). 3642 from the 2026-09-20 youth-meeting PTZ shots: a standing speaker's box is 0.93 of the frame height while head-to-knee (~1.2 m) is visible, i.e. ~1.3 m of height ~ 0.13 of the reference. The calibration model extrapolates 0.23 at this zoom, because no sweep pose was taken tighter than 2238.

sermon_zoom.source: Motor zoom logged when Subject Tracking was armed during sermons/readings on 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-20.

walking_speeds_m_per_s.source: walk_off_measured: youth0920_reader_walks_off_left_a, the box crosses 0.44 PTZ frames/s at zoom ~3640 (2.3 m wide view), a lower bound because the camera may already have been panning. normal/brisk/hurry are standard adult gait speeds used as stress levels.

latency_s.source: camera_command measured on the AW-HE120 on 2026-09-22 (motion starts 0.14-0.16 s after the HTTP command, tools/measure_motor_speed.py). video_to_detector and inference are still assumed (NDI capture ~3 frames, Apple Vision at 960 px).

manual_takeovers.what: Reader finished and walked off camera-left; PTZ lost her (source -> audience_handoff -> audience_coast) 1 s before the operator took over.
Reader at a music stand; operator took over.
Speaker with hand mic walked off camera-left while the next speaker entered; operator took over.
Operator took over after ~25 min of sermon tracking.

log_evidence.clock_offset_s: Log times lead the recording by ~4-5 s (stream encoder delay).

camera.source: Operator-confirmed model (2026-09-22); speed range from the AW-HE120 specification.

motor.source: Measured: fixtures/icas_motor_measured.json (AW-HE120, speed-with-zoom on). The Sunday-log fit in icas_stage.json is kept for reference only.
